snippet.title: Jaafar Jackson Honors Michael Movie Costume Designer Marci Rodgers | Behind the Camera Awards 2026
snippet.description:
🎬 Jaafar Jackson praised Michael costume designer Marci Rodgers for her extraordinary attention to detail in recreating his uncle Michael Jackson's iconic looks.

“When you play someone like Michael Jackson, the costume is never just a costume. His look was part of his language — the glove, the jacket, the socks, the fedora. People recognize those pieces in a split second, and they each carry decades of meaning.”

🏆 Jaafar presented Rodgers with the Best Costume Design award at Variety's Hamilton Behind the Camera Awards, held at Avalon in Hollywood on November 13, 2026.

snippet.title: Jackie, Tito & Taryll Jackson Having Fun Soundchecking “Love One Another” | Marlow, England 2023
snippet.description:
🎶 Jackie Jackson, Tito Jackson and Taryll Jackson having fun during soundcheck, performing "Love One Another" ahead of The Jacksons' appearance at Pub in the Park in Marlow, England, on May 19, 2023. 

In April 2023, Taryll began joining The Jacksons on stage, initially filling in for his uncle Marlon, who was unable to perform due to health issues, and later continuing as a backing vocalist. After Tito’s passing, Taryll performed the first two shows alongside Jackie and Marlon, but he is not performing with them on stage since. 

The other fourth guy on stage is Haydon Eshun, a veteran pop singer from England, former frontman of the 90's grossing boy band Ultimate Kaos and West End performer in Thriller Live. 

This exclusive footage was captured by Janneke van der Linden, aka Jackson Source. Footage is (also) property and courtesy of J5 Enterprises, LLC and Play It Right Entertainment, LLC.

snippet.title: The Greatest Lessons Tito Jackson "Poppa T" Taught His Son TJ (3T)
snippet.description:
During an Instagram Live in May 2020, TJ Jackson was asked about the best advice he had received from his father, affectionately known as Poppa T.

His answer was as beautiful as it was simple.

Rather than recalling a particular piece of advice, TJ reflected on the qualities he had always admired in his dad: humility, kindness, simplicity, calmness and the ability to stay positive, even when surrounded by negativity.

"Just to be humble, be kind, and chill.” — TJ Jackson

Sometimes, the greatest lessons aren't spoken. They're lived.

Tito's example, his kindness and his spirit continue to inspire those who love you.

Forever Tito Time.

snippet.title: 7 December 2026, Abu Dhabi: Michael Jackson: The Fashion Legacy Auction Evening Sale
snippet.description:
Julien's Auctions will offer four extraordinary pieces of Michael Jackson history during its Michael Jackson: The Fashion Legacy Evening Auction at Rosewood Abu Dhabi on December 7, 2026.

Leading the auction is Michael’s original black and candy-red leather jacket worn in the groundbreaking 1983 Thriller short film, alongside the rhinestone-studded glove he wore during his legendary Motown 25 performance — the night he introduced the Moonwalk to a global television audience.

Also going under the hammer are the loafers worn in the Thriller video and the loafers worn during the historic Motown 25 performance.

The four pieces represent two of the most defining moments of Michael Jackson’s career and return to auction as part of Julien’s inaugural Celebrity & Pop Culture Experience in Abu Dhabi. 

https://www.juliensauctions.com/en/auctions/michael-jackson-the-fashion-legacy-auction-evening-sale

snippet.title: Michael Jackson's Rare Video Message to the Official Dutch Jackson Fanclub (2005)
snippet.description:
In early 2005, while standing trial in the United States, Michael Jackson recorded a rare video message — one of the only public statements he was permitted to make during that period. Due to a misunderstanding within his management team, the message was mistakenly addressed to the Official Dutch Jackson Fanclub (ODJF), rather than to the organizers of the European Jackson Event for which it was originally intended.

Though unintended, the dedication proved fitting. The ODJF, through its magazine, website, and public relations efforts, had spent years actively defending Michael's reputation and supporting his family — including inviting his nephew Taj Jackson as a special guest to the European Jackson Event in Eindhoven on 6 March 2005. 

In his message, Michael thanked the fanclub directly for its "love and loyalty," a moment that remains one of the rarest pieces of Jackson fan history, recorded at a time when he was legally restricted from making public statements and had never before addressed a fan event on video.

Jackson Source is the successor to the Official Dutch Jackson Fanclub, founded and managed by Janneke van der Linden — who served the ODJF as a crew member, magazine producer, media spokesperson, and contact person, and who played a key role in bringing about this video message through her ongoing communication with Michael's team and family.

snippet.title: THE JACKSONS LEGACY: From the Family Archives
snippet.description:
📚 The Jacksons: Legacy is coming back in paperback.

Originally released in 2017, the book tells our story through exclusive interviews, family archives, rare photographs and personal memories from our journey from Gary, Indiana to stages around the world.

The new paperback edition will be released on September 29, 2026.

A special piece of Jackson family history, now available to a new generation of fans.

From the Family Archives by the Jacksons and Fred Bronson is the definitive behind-the-scenes chronicle of the Jacksons’ lives and careers.

Published in 2017 in by Thames & Hudson. 

The Jacksons: Legacy is the first ever official book on the the Royal Family of Pop. This major volume reveals the untold, unseen and utterly unforgettable story behind the legend that is the Jacksons. Four specially commissioned chapters deftly weave together an unprecedented 12 days’ worth of exclusive interviews with the brothers, recounted in their own words, with contributions from key players throughout their careers. The compelling tale unfolds from their childhood days living at 2300 Jackson Street in Gary, Indiana, through the years signed to Motown as the Jackson 5, their radical move to Epic as The Jacksons, the blossoming of their solo careers, the dizzying successes of the Victory tour, and right up to the present day.

During unrivalled access to the family archives as well as the private collections of Jackie, Marlon and Tito Jackson, bespoke photography captures a multitude of never-before-seen images, rarities and personal possessions. The result is a mind-blowing collection of visual material: intensely personal family pictures; all-angle shots of the first guitars the boys ever held; top photographer Harrison Funk’s exclusive coverage of their professional lives; photos of Michael Jackson on tour with his brothers during the release of Off The Wall (1979) and the 1982 phenomenon that was Thriller – the best-selling album of all time; editions of teen and black culture magazines featuring the family; and official merchandise, right down to Jacksons-branded breakfast cereal boxes with giveaway 7” records attached.

snippet.title: Bigi Jackson and Jermajesty Jackson Visit the MICHAEL Fan Experience in Berlin
snippet.description:
During the Global Celebrations in Berlin on April 9, 2026, Jaafar Jackson (as well as Jermajesty Jackson, Randy Jackson Jr, Prince Jackson,  Bigi Jackson, Graham King, Antoine Fuqua and Alejandra Jackson) joined his uncles Jackie Jackson and Marlon Jackson at the Fan Experience at the Uber Eats Music Hall, where fans from around the world gathered to celebrate the legacy of Michael Jackson and the film MICHAEL.

After opening with a record-breaking $217.4 million worldwide and the biggest debut ever for a musical biopic, the film has now surpassed $1 billion at the global box office — making it the first biopic in history to cross that milestone, and cementing its place as the highest-grossing biopic of all time.

Fans around the world are once again showing the strength of the Michael Jackson legacy, as the film brings his story, spirit, and essence to life, with Jaafar portraying and embodying Michael in a truly phenomenal way that only he can.

🎬 Footage captured by and courtesy of Janneke van der Linden (Jackson Source).

snippet.title: TJ Jackson on News On 6 talks Tunes & Spoons Festival, father Tito’s legacy and MICHAEL Movie
snippet.description:
TJ Jackson joined Dave Davis again on Oklahoma's Own (News On 6) to discuss his father Tito's connection to Claremore, this weekend’s Tunes & Spoons Festival and his reaction to the Michael Jackson movie.

The second edition of Tunes & Spoons Chili Cook-Off and Music Festival was held August 21–23, 2026, at the Claremore Expo Center, featuring award-winning music, delicious chili, and family attractions. More than just a festival, Tunes & Spoons is a living tribute to Tito’s legacy of unity, resilience, and joy. The event carries a personal connection for TJ Jackson, son of the late Tito Jackson, founding member of the Jackson 5 and The Jacksons. 

In 2023, Tito Jackson became a proud resident of Claremore, where he purchased a ranch and soon fell in love with the town’s charm, its people, and the peaceful way of life that gave him rest and a sense of belonging. He spent hours fishing at his private pond and connecting with neighbors. This special connection with Claremore became the foundation for his vision to give back through music, food, and togetherness.

At the heart of the festival is Music Giving Hope, the nonprofit co-founded by Tito Jackson with partners Terry Harvey, Rob Miller, Howard Pollack, and Brad White. The foundation is dedicated to empowering communities through the transformative power of music. By combining music with community initiatives, Music Giving Hope ensures that Tito’s dream continues to inspire future generations. Tito’s family and community partners proudly carry forward his vision: to bring people together through music, food, and togetherness.
​
Watch TJ Jackson’s chat with host Dave Davis on News On 6, broadcast live on Friday, August 221st, on Oklahoma’s Own, courtesy of News On 6.
